bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Padova's center-back injury crisis tests winless-at-home Arezzo's blunt attack.

spf.comment: Covers both the primary 1:1 stalemate and the 1:2 Padova transition win, as Arezzo's 0-2-3 home record and Padova's depleted backline create genuine two-way uncertainty rather than a clear single-outcome lock.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.46 combined lambda, Poisson's 55.4% Under projection, and Padova's 63.6% season Under 2.5 rate alongside missing attackers on both rosters.

btts.comment: Padova have scored in all five away matches against an Arezzo side conceding 1.82 goals per game, while Padova's three absent centre-backs weaken their clean-sheet integrity.

score.comment: A 1:1 draw reflects the 12.5% Poisson peak adjusted for Padova's defensive absences, with 1:2 capturing Padova's superior midfield progression late.

goals.comment: Two goals is the modal 25.9% Poisson outcome matching 1:1, while three goals covers the 21.2% secondary branch of a 1:2 away victory.

bqc.comment: Arezzo's 60% home half-time draw rate and zero first-half home goals point to a level interval before settling 1:1 or tipping late to Padova.
